name: kudosity-mcp
description: Send SMS, MMS and WhatsApp, manage contacts and webhooks, and explore the Kudosity API.
long_description:
Gives Claude native tools for the Kudosity messaging platform: send SMS, MMS and WhatsApp messages, check delivery status and inbound replies, manage contact lists and webhooks, check your balance, and search the live Kudosity API reference.

You need a Kudosity account and API key (Settings → API Settings in the Kudosity platform). The API secret is optional and only needed for the contact-list and balance tools.

Sending a message is billable and irreversible, so Claude always asks before sending.

tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: Send an SMS to a recipient

tools.name: send_mms
tools.description: Send an MMS with a media attachment

tools.name: send_whatsapp
tools.description: Send a WhatsApp message (free-form text or approved template)

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Get a sent message and its status by channel and ID

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: List sent or received messages with delivery status

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Register an HTTPS webhook for delivery status, inbound messages, link hits, opt-outs

tools.name: get_list
tools.description: Get a contact list and optionally its members

tools.name: add_contact_to_list
tools.description: Add a contact to a list

tools.name: remove_contact_from_list
tools.description: Remove a contact from a list

tools.name: list_endpoints
tools.description: List all endpoints for an API spec

tools.name: search_endpoints
tools.description: Search the Kudosity API reference by keyword

tools.name: get_endpoint
tools.description: Get full detail for one API endpoint

api_key.title: Kudosity API key
api_key.description: From the Kudosity platform: Settings → API Settings. Used for messaging, webhooks and reporting.

api_secret.title: Kudosity API secret (optional)
api_secret.description: Same page as the API key. Only needed for the contact-list and balance tools; leave blank otherwise.
